constraints: The default table for the process is used when aTable is omitted.
If a set with the same name already exists, it is cleared/replaced by the new empty set.
CREATE SET already implicitly creates the set it targets, so calling CREATE EMPTY SET first is unnecessary before CREATE SET.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Creates (or clears, if it already exists) a new empty set for a table, ready to be populated via ADD TO SET.
